commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---dispatched as---"; grep -n "dispatched as \`devflow:<name>\`" docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md; echo "---context---"; grep -n "devflow:<name>\|keep validating and resolving\|pre-rename spellings" docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md
printf 'GITHUB_ACTIONS=%s\n' "$GITHUB_ACTIONS"; git branch --show-current; grep -n 'dispatched as' docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md

DEVFLOW_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
mkdir -p "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body"
gh issue view 1088 --json body --jq '.body' > "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1088.md"
wc -c "$DEVFLOW_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1088.md"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1088 --reflection-kind blocked --reflection-file .prflow/tmp/refl-1088.md 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -f .prflow/tmp/refl-1088.md
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1088 --reflection-kind improvement --reflection-file /dev/stdin <<'EOF' 2>&1 | tail -1
Cloud /prflow:implement completion is machine-gated (issue #1087 _terminal_complete_gate) on an in-env full-suite pass, but the cloud implement host runs every shard on one shared machine and both  …[per-command-truncated]

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment 5157472385 --reaction -1 --report-failure 2>&1 | tail -2 || true
rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-1088" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1088.md" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "done"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
